beats.narration_en: Why are hundreds of new cars stacked in this glass tower?
It's a car tower next to a factory in Wolfsburg Germany.
New cars roll in from the factory through a tunnel.
A robot arm on a central mast picks each one up.
It turns to face an empty bay and climbs almost seven feet a second.
Then it slides the car in like a book onto a shelf.
With no ramps or lanes the cars pack in tight.
Each tower holds four hundred cars on twenty floors.
When a buyer arrives the robot brings their car down in under two minutes.
It's the fastest automated parking system in the world.
That's why new cars here wait in a glass tower for their owners.
